risks.risk: No dimensions given, affects fit and value
risks.proof: Photo with tape measure or stated measurements

risks.risk: Age of item unknown, affects wear expectations
risks.proof: Purchase receipt or seller statement with date, cross-checked against wear visible in photos

proof_requests: Photo of the wardrobe's rear and side panels
Video of doors and drawers opening/closing and locks engaging
Close-up photo of the base showing wheels/tyres if present
Photo with a tape measure for height, width, depth
Close-up of any wear, scratches or stains on the surface
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item type and key visible features, but several condition and functional claims are unverifiable from the photo alone, so it should be priced at worst case pending proof.
